verdict.rationale: Authy's feature page says users can "easily capture 2FA QR codes" from major services, and it describes PIN/TouchID-protected 2FA tokens that work offline. Community users confirm they rely on the app day to day for 2FA codes on their phones. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the scan-to-code setup flow and evidence that codes appear immediately after scanning, plus independent hands-on corroboration of QR enrollment specifically.
